figures.caption: Table 3: Structural fidelity and mechanism adherence (win-path F1) for each (model, condition) cell. Structural fidelity is computed only on runtime-pass records (n varies, shown in subscript); mechanism adherence is computed on all 858 attempts. Lose-path scores appear in Appendix A.6. The constant 0.12 floor across all no-schema cells reflects three patterns (Evade, Guard, Survive) whose ground-truth win paths are empty; the F1(∅, ∅) = 1.0 convention produces 3/26 ≈ 0.12 regardless of model output. — indicates no data: Qwen2.5×Full-scene was excluded due to context overflow; Gemma4×Full-scene had zero runtime-pass records (n=0).

Table 2: Compile and runtime success rates per model and IR condition. C = compile success; R = runtime success. Counts in parentheses; runtime success is a strict subset of compile success. Qwen2.5 × full-scene is excluded due to 32K context overflow.
Figure 2: Screenshot of the “Ownership” goal playable concept running in the browser. The player controls the large blue box and must collide with all small white boxes to claim ownership.

Table 4: Pairwise McNemar exact tests on per-pattern any-pass aggregation. propA and propB are the proportions of 26 patterns with at least one runtime-passing seed under condition A and B respectively. OR is the discordance odds ratio with 95% Woolf CI; Cohen’s h measures effect size. * indicates p < 0.05.
Table 5: Top 10 compile-error codes across the 858 evaluation attempts. NS = no-schema, BO = behavior-only, FS = full-scene.

Table 6: Per-pattern aggregate results. Fidelity is the mean of four structural-fidelity sub-dimensions (scripts, GO names, component types, tags F1) over IR-conditioned runtime-pass records; mechanism is win-path steps F1 over all 858 records, macro-averaged over the four models and three conditions.
